acceptanceCriteria: A refused complete leaves an observable, bounded journal fact and closeout-debt reports COMPLETE_REFUSED with the refusal code, with a test.
HELD and DRAFT tickets cited by merged commits are reported with their status, or their exclusion is specified with reason.
The TCD spec is amended and the read-only proof still passes.
body: V1-1615 (PR #1058) added the read-only `corvint-tasks ticket closeout-debt` verb (TCD-V0-001..010). Residuals: (1) a refused `complete` writes no journal record, so the verb cannot report COMPLETE_REFUSED and shows GATES_PASSED_COMPLETE_PENDING instead; (2) HELD and DRAFT tickets cited by merged work are out of scope.
title: closeout-debt: observe refused complete attempts and cover HELD/DRAFT tickets (V1-1615 residuals)
